verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows none. The only API evidence is a keyless JSON endpoint on the Socrata open-data platform (data.colorado.gov). That is a host-platform capability, not the registry's own, and it is not an interactive reference with runnable examples. The data.colorado.gov exploration canvas is a dataset filtering UI, an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
